verdict.rationale: Browserbase's Agents documentation says agents can process downloaded content such as PDFs and spreadsheets, retrieved via the Downloads API. That is first-party, hosted file handling, but the docs do not explicitly describe text extraction and never mention Word or PowerPoint. The URL-to-markdown fetch converts web pages, not office documents, so it does not count here. missing for 10: explicit document text-extraction docs, Word (.docx) support, PowerPoint (.pptx) support, extraction-quality details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself

citations.quote: Process downloaded content such as PDFs and spreadsheets.
Retrieve it with the Downloads API using the sessionId from the run.
